from pathlib import Path
programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u018/system/state/workspace/programs')
programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
path=programs/'task-09e17784.py'
code='''from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    row_divs = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][c] != bg]
    def segments(n, divs):
        out=[]; start=0
        for d in divs:
            if start < d: out.append(list(range(start,d)))
            start=d+1
        if start<n: out.append(list(range(start,n)))
        return out
    rs=segments(h,row_divs); cs=segments(w,col_divs)
    regions=[(ri,ci) for ri in range(len(rs)) for ci in range(len(cs))]
    def score(region):
        ri,ci=region
        return sum(grid[r][c] != bg for r in rs[ri] for c in cs[ci])
    source=max(regions,key=score)
    sr,sc=source
    pattern=[[grid[r][c] for c in cs[sc]] for r in rs[sr]]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri,rr in enumerate(rs):
        for ci,cc in enumerate(cs):
            if (ri,ci)==source: continue
            if len(rr)==len(pattern) and len(cc)==len(pattern[0]):
                for i,r in enumerate(rr):
                    for j,c in enumerate(cc): out[r][c]=pattern[i][j]
    return out
'''
path.write_text(code)
